headline: Traffic control plan for the Washington & Main Streets CSO project, plus parking on Parkview Court and Cherry Ln.
summary: Parking is also on the list: a request for on-street parking on Parkview Court and a proposal to remove on-street parking on Cherry Ln. Staff will also give a memorandum of understanding and an update on the Lester B. Orcutt Blvd. traffic review.
